reader.requirement: At --std 85 FUNCTION LENGTH of a group that contains an OCCURS DEPENDING ON table returns the group's size with the table counted at the current value of its DEPENDING data item, as for a sending item (§1985:VI.5.8.4 GR3), whether data-name-1 is inside or outside the group and whatever the group's nesting.

reader.edition-search: grep of IntrinsicBinder.cs (VariableLengthGroupSum), ItemLength.cs, PlaceBuilder.cs and IntrinsicRenderer.cs for Edition, DialectLevel, DialectBehavior: the ODO sum takes no edition input; the only edition reads on the path are the function window and the 2014 PHYSICAL gate.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f36_03 covers data-name-1 outside the group and inside it, at two values each; it does not cover zero occurrences (integer-1 = 0), the maximum, a subgroup holding the table, a COMP member in the element, a reference-modified ODO group, or a statement whose receiver is data-name-1.

reader.notes: VariableLengthGroupSum builds fixed part + data-name-1's current value x element width, which is the sending-item rule of §1985:VI.5.8.4 GR3 b. 1985 forbids an ODO table under another OCCURS (VI.5.8.3 SR1 b), so the single-level shapes probed are the whole range the edition allows.

refuter.evidence: Probe rlen1.cob at --std 85 (runs/rlen1-001): DEPENDING item S9(3) PACKED-DECIMAL at 4 -> 21 (1 + 4*5), after MOVE 6 -> 31; an FD record with its own ODO (FRN 9(2), X(3) OCCURS 1 TO 9 DEPENDING ON FRN) at FRN 3 -> 11; the evaluation uses the DEPENDING value current when the function is evaluated, as AR2 requires.
